Vordingborg is a Danish municipality featured in national healthcare quality assessments for atrial fibrillation treatment. In the 2022–2023 Annual Report from the Danish Atrial Fibrillation Database (AFDK), published by the Danish Regions' Clinical Quality Development Programme (RKKP), Vordingborg is included in a comprehensive breakdown of all 98 Danish municipalities [^src1]. Its specific significance in this corpus lies in its data regarding stroke (apoplexy) events among atrial fibrillation patients, which feeds into the DanStroke-based calculations for Indicator 5 (the prevention of ischemic stroke via anticoagulation treatment) [^src1]. The report's municipal data tables list Vordingborg's specific patient counts, rates, and statistical intervals for these stroke prevention metrics [^src1]. Because the available evidence consists of a single tabular entry, no further details regarding the municipality's broader context or specific clinical outcomes are documented in this dataset.
